summary: Nano Labs Ltd filed a Form 6-K on August 28, 2026, announcing its unaudited financial results for H1 2026. The report details net revenue of RMB2.8 million, a net loss of RMB316.7 million, and a loss on fair value changes of cryptocurrencies of RMB250.5 million. Management highlighted the launch of the iPollo ClawPC A1 Mini and the expansion of the OpenClaw ecosystem, alongside a digital asset reserve strategy of 70,000 BNB. This is a routine earnings release with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing contains no deal terms, board actions, or strategic review announcements. Watch for evolving digital asset strategy as the company integrates crypto into capital allocation.
